title: Implement 404-vs-403 cross-tenant access protection
acceptance_criteria: 404 returned (not 403) when tenant does not own a resource — prevents tenant enumeration
Repository layer automatically handles 404: findById returns null → route returns 404
Unauthenticated access to tenant-scoped routes returns 401, not 404 or 403
Authenticated access to cross-tenant resource returns 404, never reveals existence of other tenant's data
Migration script adds NOT EXISTS check guideline to all new route handlers
Security test case exists verifying cross-tenant returns 404 not 403
